title: A Survey Measured Tattoos On 32% Of US Adults
hook: Survey data says tattoos crossed from rebellion into the mainstream.
closing: In this survey, tattoos were common enough to look mainstream rather than rebellious.
question: How many tattoos do you have?

segments.say: Surveyed tattoo prevalence reached 32 percent, doubling its earlier share.
The survey measured tattoos on 37 percent of women, above the adult average.
The survey found 22 percent of adults had multiple tattoos, making repeat ink common.
